---
title: "Sarasota Hourly Weather"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)

weather <- read_rds("sarasota_weather.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: temperature-plot
weather |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = temperature_2m)) +
  geom_line(color = "coral2", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "coral4", size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(
    title = "Hourly Temperature in Sarasota, Florida",
    subtitle = "Past 7 days of hourly observations",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Temperature (°C)",
    caption = "Source: Open-Meteo API"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
